title: Sparse empirical measures for non-statistical interval maps with two neutral fixed points
summary: We consider balanced doubly intermittent full-branch interval maps with two neutral fixed points. Although the ordinary empirical measures fail to converge for Lebesgue-almost every initial point, we show that this non-statistical behavior persists under a broad class of deterministic observation schemes: if the sampling sequence is block-dominating, then both endpoint Dirac masses are accumulation points of the sparse empirical measures for Lebesgue-almost every orbit.
